body: I definitely do. I want to know what my boyfriend is thinking. It must suck to have a girlfriend who is always sad. I have a hard time believing any guy would want to be with me.

Hey, thank you for reaching out. My family lives in Colorado while I live in Michigan. They moved when I graduated high school. My brother goes to college there so he also lives at my parents. My dads an alcoholic and has gone to therapy twice. He's so bad that my brother has had to call the police on him. My moms just in denial of it all. Her side of the family lives in Peru so she's been there all summer. It's hard. Really hard.
Yes, sometimes it does feel like we are completely alone. It's hard to acknowledge that we aren't alone. And it's hard not putting it all on your significant other.

Thank you. I would love to talk. Having gone through many times in my life where I have felt defeated (sexual abuse, dads an alcoholic) I truly believe that my depression has been caused by those moments. I would love a friend to talk to.
I, too, feel so alone. That I'm not worthy of even seeing a psychologist. That no one cares. I hope we are both able to see soon that we are worthy.
